nodes.label: Deletion Requests
nodes.desc: 518 full-run requests + 32 public samples. Each has case_id, email, audit_at, request_text.

nodes.label: Intent (LLM)
nodes.desc: Classifies request_text into DELETE_REQUEST / DELETION_VERIFICATION / OTHER_SERVICE via batched, cached Gemini Flash-Lite calls (thinking off); a deterministic keyword fallback covers the no-API-key case. Only OTHER_SERVICE maps to NOT_APPLICABLE.

nodes.label: Identity Resolution
nodes.desc: Maps a request's email to a user_id and the full historical identifier set (current + historical emails, hashes, phones, names) via user_identities.csv and user_audit_log.csv.

nodes.label: Evidence Ingest
nodes.desc: Parses the 94-file evidence corpus (SQL dumps, JSON, logs, system_activity.csv claims) once into observations.jsonl. PDF/PNG evidence is parsed by separate scripts not wired into this step (see docs/DECISIONS.md D8-D10).

nodes.label: Point-in-time State
nodes.desc: For each (system_id, resource_id) linked to a user, takes the latest observation at or before audit_at. File evidence outranks activity claims; PRESENT beats ABSENT on an exact-timestamp tie (replica drift).

nodes.label: Policy / Account Rules
nodes.desc: Resolves the account_service resource for every case via a priority chain: direct evidence link -> catalog link -> same-day deletion_worker batch order -> zero-padded user-number fallback.

nodes.label: Planner
nodes.desc: Turns resolved resource states into an ordered FINDING -> REMEDIATION -> VERIFICATION step list and derives the case's COMPLETE/INCOMPLETE/NOT_APPLICABLE status.

nodes.label: Validator
nodes.desc: Checks output.csv's contract: row count, sort order, step numbering/ordering, evidence-citation rules, operation/state consistency.

nodes.label: output.csv
nodes.desc: Final submission artifact: case_id, deletion_status, steps_json.
